title: KKR, Singtel and Tata Communications put data centre company STT GDC India up for sale at over $5.5 billion
excerpt: In a significant move, KKR, Singtel, and Tata Communications are gearing up to offload STT Global Data Centres India, anticipating a valuation that could surpass $5.5 billion. This initiative underscores their intent to bolster capital and refine strategic objectives. With 34 data centres in operation, STT GDC India stands as a leading co-location service provider, well-poised to capitalize on the escalating appetite for data infrastructure amidst evolving tech trends.

title: Nifty’s next move hinges on breakout above 23,200: Analysts
excerpt: Nifty has recently surged by nearly 2%, approaching the resistance level at 23,200. Analysts recommend building long positions to capitalize on a potential breakout. Support is set between 22,600 and 22,800, serving as a buffer. Recommended stocks for investment this week include DLF and Zensar Technologies. Investors should exercise caution in the broader market until significant resistance levels are broken.

title: FPI buying returns to Dalal Street as global investors rethink AI bets
excerpt: Foreign portfolio investors have shifted from aggressive selling to net buying of Indian equities recently. They invested nearly $1.2 billion over the last ten trading sessions, particularly in large-cap stocks. This change in behavior may be attributed to concerns regarding the artificial intelligence trade influencing investor decisions. Globally, markets saw corrections, while Indian indices had a mixed performance in October.

title: Zen Technologies shares rally 9% after Q2 profit rises 51% YoY, revenue nearly doubles

title: Rupee falls 21 paise to 94.97 against US dollar in early trade
excerpt: In the early hours of trading, the rupee fell by 21 paise to 94.97 against the US dollar, influenced by a firmer dollar along with local market dynamics. However, persistent inflation concerns and calls by three US Federal Reserve officials for further rate hikes could limit gains in the non-yielding precious metals. The Fed had left interest rates unchanged at its previous policy meeting.

title: Reliance Industries shares set for biggest-single day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 1 lakh crore rally
excerpt: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 7.5% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

title: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February
excerpt: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.

title: Japan bond yields edge higher ahead of key JGB auctions; 10-year yield holds at 2.77%
excerpt: Japanese government bond yields were mixed on Monday, with the 10-year benchmark holding steady at 2.77%, while the 20-year and 30-year yields rose. title: Darius Khambata does not seek re-appointment on Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and Sir Ratan Tata Trust as his term ends

title: Spandana Sphoorty reports Rs 7.8 crore cyber fraud in bank account
excerpt: Spandana Sphoorty reported cyber fraud that led to unauthorized transactions of Rs 7.8 crore. The fraud was discovered on Sunday, prompting immediate action from the microfinance company. A senior official stated that the company has insurance that covers the losses incurred due to the fraud. Services associated with the fraud were halted, and investigations are currently underway. The company has requested its bank to reverse the transactions and investigate further.

title: SBI Q2 Results Preview: PAT may rise up to 25% YoY; NII, margins, deposit growth in focus

title: Equity capital vital, market's concerns merit attention: FM Sitharaman
excerpt: Asserts there is no fragility in the economy and India needs less cynicism

ai.title_te: సీనియర్ ఫైనాన్షియల్ న్యూస్ అనలిస్ట్ మరియు "తెలుగు మార్కెట్ పల్స్" ప్రధాన సంపాదకుడిగా, నేను ఈ వార్తను విశ్లేషిస్తున్నాను. ప్రభుత్వం ప్రైవేట్ పెట్టుబడులు పెరగే వరకు క్యాపెక్స్ (Capex) పెంచుతూనే ఉంటుందని ఆర్థిక మంత్రి నిర్ధారించారు.
ai.summary: ఆర్థిక మంత్రి నిర్మలా సీతారామన్, ప్రైవేట్ పెట్టుబడులు (Private Investment) బలపడే వరకు ప్రభుత్వం తన క్యాపెక్స్ (Capex) ఖర్చులను కొనసాగిస్తుందని స్పష్టం చేశారు. భారతదేశ ఆర్థిక ప్రాథమికాలు (Fundamentals) బలంగా ఉన్నాయని, మార్కెట్పై ఎక్కువ ఆశాభావం పెంచుకోవాలని ఆమె సూచించారు.
ai.summary_te: ఆర్థిక మంత్రి నిర్మలా సీతారామన్, ప్రైవేట్ పెట్టుబడులు (Private Investment) బలపడే వరకు ప్రభుత్వం తన క్యాపెక్స్ (Capex) ఖర్చులను కొనసాగిస్తుందని స్పష్టం చేశారు. భారతదేశ ఆర్థిక ప్రాథమికాలు (Fundamentals) బలంగా ఉన్నాయని, మార్కెట్పై ఎక్కువ ఆశాభావం పెంచుకోవాలని ఆమె సూచించారు.
ai.why: ప్రభుత్వ క్యాపెక్స్ పెరగడం ద్వారా నిర్మాణ, ఇన్ఫ్రా రంగాలకు అదనపు ఆదాయం లభిస్తుంది, ఇది మొత్తం GDP వృద్ధిని మరియు మార్కెట్ సెంటిమెంట్‌ను బలపరుస్తుంది.
ai.why_it_matters_te: ప్రభుత్వ క్యాపెక్స్ పెరగడం ద్వారా నిర్మాణ, ఇన్ఫ్రా రంగాలకు అదనపు ఆదాయం లభిస్తుంది, ఇది మొత్తం GDP వృద్ధిని మరియు మార్కెట్ సెంటిమెంట్‌ను బలపరుస్తుంది.
ai.market_impact_te: ఇన్ఫ్రా మరియు మెటల్స్ స్టాక్స్‌పై సానుకూల ప్రభావం ఉండే అవకాశం ఉంది.
ai.impact_reason_te: ప్రభుత్వం రోడ్లు, రైలువెళ్ళలు, పోర్ట్లు వంటి ప్రాజెక్టులపై ఖర్చు పెంచినప్పుడు, నిర్మాణ కంపెనీలకు కొత్త ఆర్డర్లు వస్తాయి. దీనివల్ల వాటి భవిష్యత్ ఆదాయం (Revenue) మరియు లాభాలు పెరుగుతాయి.

ai.market_impact_te: బిట్‌కాయిన్ స్థిరంగా ఉండటంతో క్రిప్టో మార్కెట్‌లో తాత్కాలిక స్థిరత్వం, కానీ భద్రతా లీక్ కారణంగా పెట్టుబడిదారులు జాగ్రత్త.
ai.impact_reason_te: భద్రతా లీక్ కారణంగా పెట్టుబడిదారుల విశ్వాసం తగ్గి, డిజిటల్ ఆస్తుల డిమాండ్ తగ్గుతుంది, తద్వారా ధరలు స్థిరంగా ఉంటాయి.

title: Marico Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 31% YoY to Rs 550 crore, revenue rises 12%

title: Sebi issues rules for depositary receipts on REITs, InvITs units
excerpt: India's market regulator has unveiled a new framework enabling foreign investors to invest in REITs and InvITs, aiming to boost foreign capital in these sectors. title: IPO-bound StockGro's profit jumps 3-fold to Rs 113 cr in FY26 on strong revenue growth
excerpt: In FY26, StockGro showcased substantial growth, achieving a profit after tax of Rs 112.96 crore while nearly doubling its revenue to Rs 226.14 crore, largely propelled by rising subscription fees. title: IPO fundraising rises 30% to record ₹84,400 crore in H1FY27: Report

As many as 71 companies made their stock market debut during April-September 2026, compared with 55 in the corresponding period a year ago.

title: Institutional investors step up bets on private credit as insurers, pension funds and DFIs back new funds
excerpt: Institutional investors are now allocating more funds to private credit, significantly from insurance companies and pension funds. Neo Alternative Asset Managers has seen its second fund receive 22-25% contributions from these investors. Ascertis Credit's fourth fund also attracted commitments exceeding $700 million from multiple institutional investors. With increased interest in private credit, annual investment opportunities are now estimated around ₹1 lakh crore.

title: Sudarshan Venu family trusts pledge TVS shares to fund TSF stake buy
excerpt: Sudarshan Venu's trusts have secured ₹825 crore through share pledges to acquire an additional stake in TVS Holdings. The acquisition will raise Sudarshan's stake to 73.35%, enhancing family ownership. Funds from JM Financial Products and JM Financial Credit Solutions will finance this transaction. TVS Holdings reported a 39% increase in consolidated revenue, demonstrating strong business performance. This realignment of ownership reflects Sudarshan's growing role in the group’s future direction.
